+import argparse
+import numpy as np
+import casa_tool
+
+BASE = np.array([2.67441, -2.13856, 0.897776])
+
+def to_base(p):
+    p = np.asarray(p) - BASE
+    return np.array([p[1], -p[0], p[2]])
+
+def pos(s, body):
+    return s.data.xpos[s.model.body(body).id].copy()
+
+def grip(s, side='right'):
+    return s.data.site_xpos[s.model.site(f'gripper0_{side}_grip_site').id].copy()
+
+def run(args):
+    s = casa_tool.Session('/app/instance.npz')
+    a = s.targets.copy()
+    init = a.copy()
+    def report(stage):
+        p = pos(s,'obj_main'); h=grip(s); c=pos(s,'container_main')
+        print(stage, len(s.actions), 'pep',np.round(p,3),'grip',np.round(h,3),'delta',np.round(p-h,3), 'shelf',np.round(c,3),'success',s.check()['success'],flush=True)
+    def move(stage, world, hand, n):
+        nonlocal a
+        p0=a[:3].copy(); p1=to_base(world)
+        h0=a[12:18].copy(); h1=np.asarray(hand)
+        for i in range(n):
+            t=(i+1)/n
+            # smooth starting and stopping
+            t=t*t*(3-2*t)
+            a[:3]=p0+(p1-p0)*t
+            a[12:18]=h0+(h1-h0)*t
+            s.step(a)
+        report(stage)
+    report('initial')
+    move('approach',(args.x,args.y,args.z),np.zeros(6),args.approach)
+    move('close',(args.x,args.y,args.z),[args.f]*4+[args.thumb,args.rot],args.close)
+    move('lift',(args.x,args.y+0.07,args.z+0.15),[args.f]*4+[args.thumb,args.rot],args.lift)
+    s.save_trajectory()
+    print('saved',len(s.actions))
+    if args.render:
+        from PIL import Image
+        Image.fromarray(s.render_grid()).save('/app/output/after.png')
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument('--x',type=float,default=2.865)
+    ap.add_argument('--y',type=float,default=-1.92)
+    ap.add_argument('--z',type=float,default=0.99)
+    ap.add_argument('--f',type=float,default=1.2)
+    ap.add_argument('--thumb',type=float,default=1.0)
+    ap.add_argument('--rot',type=float,default=1.0)
+    ap.add_argument('--approach',type=int,default=40)
+    ap.add_argument('--close',type=int,default=50)
+    ap.add_argument('--lift',type=int,default=40)
+    ap.add_argument('--render',action='store_true')
+    run(ap.parse_args())
